name: annual_oi_spot_participation_path
objective: Find a regime-agnostic, annually refit long/short BTC sleeve whose delayed open-interest and spot-versus-perpetual participation features add positive marginal value to the frozen Gross9 portfolio.

primary_axes: complete Binance spot close and volume
OI growth relative to spot cash participation
perpetual taker imbalance as an execution-context control
explicitly_excluded: Rank7 nested-barrier and market-braid weak features
unavailable spot quote-volume, taker-flow, and trade-count columns
novelty_boundary.relationship_to_rank7: This is a separate annual model with different anchors, direct spot-volume/OI axes, fixed-hold long/short execution, and no Rank7 funding/premium source gate or barrier exits.

feature_contract.spot_completeness: spot_rows must equal 5 at the decision bar
feature_contract.missing_source_policy: fail closed at inference; no forward fill
feature_contract.rolling_statistics: trailing-only; z-score center and scale use observations ending one completed bar before the current value

participation: log rolling spot notional divided by rolling perpetual quote volume at 1h, 4h, and 24h
prior-window z-scores of spot and perpetual log volume
open_interest: delayed OI log return at 1h, 4h, and 24h
delayed OI return minus perpetual return
delayed OI return minus spot return
delayed OI value divided by 24h spot notional

model_contract.learner: two HistGradientBoostingRegressors, one for executable long utility and one for executable short utility
model_contract.target: next-open fixed-hold net return after two 6bp/notional side costs minus risk_lambda times side-specific leveraged intratrade MAE
model_contract.target_clip: fit-fold 0.5% and 99.5% winsorization independently by side
model_contract.purge: a fit target is allowed only when its source-owned exit is strictly before the fold fit_end
model_contract.prediction_threshold: side-max confidence must exceed the frozen quantile of fit-fold predictions and be positive

execution_contract.entry: next 5m open after the completed decision bar
execution_contract.exit: fixed hold at a future 5m open; no TP or SL
execution_contract.annualization: full declared calendar window including idle cash

requirements: 2023 and 2024 absolute return are both positive
2023 and 2024 each have at least 12 trades and each half-year has at least 4 trades
standalone_pre2025.rank: maximize minimum 2023/2024 ratio, then geometric mean ratio, then minimum half-year return, then combined absolute return, then lower model complexity and lexical policy order

requirements: total gross <= 10 with added weight on the frozen 0.25 grid
train strict MDD <= 40% and 2024 strict MDD <= 20%
train and 2024 absolute returns remain positive and at least 97% of baseline
minimum train/2024 Gross9 CAGR-to-strict-MDD delta is positive
gross9_top1.rank: maximize minimum train/2024 Gross9 ratio delta, then geometric mean positive ratio delta, then 2024 MDD reduction, then 2024 return delta, then lower added weight

requirements: 2025 and 2026 use only their annually expanding past-data refits
frozen portfolio 2025 and 2026 returns remain positive, strict MDD <= 20%, and ratio >= 3
neither future Gross9 ratio falls by more than 0.25 and at least one improves
standalone combined 2025-2026 absolute return is positive
10bp/side stress keeps frozen portfolio future returns positive

required_diagnostics: prediction and schedule hashes by annual fold
seed rerun equality for deterministic learner
exact entry and occupied-bar overlap versus every Gross9 sleeve
feature permutation and OI/spot ablation diagnostics after top1 freeze
research_caveat: 2025/2026 have been inspected elsewhere, so future stages are veto-only and cannot restore pristine OOS status. A passing model is a forward-shadow retraining process, not an automatic live promotion.
